meta.title: My Packing List
meta.textType: functional: a packing list with colors and sizes

paragraphs: Lily's class is going to climb the hill on Friday. Teacher Kim has a big tent for the day camp. Tonight, Lily is going to write a packing list. Dad sits at her desk and reads the paper from school. "You should take light things," he says. Lily writes each thing with a color and a size. She writes a big blue water bottle and a small red bag. Then she adds a white hat, black sunglasses, and green trainers. "The trainers are important," says Dad. "A long walk can make your feet sore." Lily nods.

Dad looks at the big umbrella by the door. "It is heavy, and the sky is blue," he says. So Lily leaves the umbrella at home. Dad puts a bandage in the small red bag. Lily puts a snack in a plastic box. The snack is an apple and a banana. "Be careful on the hill," says Dad. "You are going to walk up a long path." "At the top, you are going to see a great view." Lily smiles and asks, "What time is the bus?" "It is at half past seven," says Dad.

The list also has her school sports uniform. Lily draws a small picture next to each thing. She puts a tick by a thing when it is in the bag. The bottle, the sunglasses, and the trainers get a tick. The hat has no tick. Pip sits and watches.

Lily looks at the list again. The hat is not in the bag. "Where is your hat?" asks Dad. They look on the desk and under the bed. Then Lily sees the small red bag. Pip is in the open bag, and the white hat is on his head. Lily laughs and lifts him out of the bag. "You are not going to the hill, Pip," she says. Pip moves his tail, and Dad laughs, too. Now the hat gets a tick. Lily is ready.
text.summary: Lily's class is going to climb a hill and have a day camp. Lily writes a packing list with Dad, and Pip hides in the bag.
